workloads.purpose: Bootstrap once, then prove unchanged steady-state observations do not require semantic churn.
Exercise same-document route/state changes and safe document-generation or reset behavior.
Exercise bounded scrolling, lazy inserts, stable identity, and boundary detection.
Exercise detach/reinsert identity retention and bounded remove grace.
Measure task-irrelevant churn without allowing missed later relevant changes.
Measure one semantic update against a full rich snapshot.
Prove continuity loss forces RESET/full-snapshot recovery rather than stale continuation.
Measure round-trip and wall-clock cost for bounded repeated observe/filter/collect work.
Bounded lazy-feed collection with deduplication, stable boundary verification, and no focus takeover.
Structured repeated entities plus SPA/navigation changes on an unrelated application shape.
Dynamic/media-oriented page with high irrelevant churn and repeated content regions.

inheritedAcceptedMeasurements.notes: These accepted 1.6.0 measurements predate P0 and are reference evidence only. They are not relabeled as fresh exact-head P0 live measurements.

exactHeadLiveMeasurements.reason: P0 is contract/baseline freeze only; no browser, extension, MCP, database, Edge, OAuth, production, or transaction runtime mutation is authorized. Fresh paired real-site measurements are reserved for P5.
